summary: Tests comprehensively cover all three retention policies (max-age, keep-latest, max-total-size), combined policies, dry-run vs real mode, and error scenarios (missing input, missing file, malformed input, unknown options). Workflow structure tests validate YAML, triggers, jobs, permissions, and actionlint. However, tests reference fixture files (tests/fixtures/basic.tsv, keep_latest.tsv, size.tsv, combined.tsv, malformed.tsv) that are not provided and have no setup code to create them—these files are missing from the workspace. Without them, the bats test suite will not execute. The act integration portion is well-designed and creates ci-fixtures dynamically, but bats tests lack this portability. Also missing: explicit test for invalid numeric policy values (implementation validates but test doesn't verify the error). Test organization and naming are clear, but lack of self-contained fixtures is a critical design flaw.
